editorial:
Imagine waking up during a brutal heat wave only to find out the rain is actually acid that melts everything it touches. You follow a young girl and her parents who are barely speaking to each other because of a messy divorce. As France falls into total chaos, these three have to stop fighting and actually work together to survive. The vibe is very tense and scary, making you feel the heat and the panic as the world falls apart around them. It is less about big explosions and more about how a broken family tries to fix itself while the sky is literally falling.

What really works here is the acting, as the tension between the parents feels very real. The pacing starts slow but picks up speed as the rain gets worse. Some parts might feel a bit too quiet for people who want non-stop action, but the suspense is great.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the family finds a safe spot, but the acid rain continues to destroy the city. They realize there is no quick fix for the climate disaster. The movie ends with them finally bonded as a family, choosing to protect each other even though the future looks grim. It is a sad but hopeful ending that shows love is the only thing left when the world ends.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival stories and family dramas.
